data.plainLyric:
Everybody wants to know if
I'm missing you
I see Archie next week
I'm gonna tell him not to tell me
A thing about you
I'll hear it from your own mouth
When I touch back down
Cause I don't know when to stop digging

But when I think about having babies
They're not just anyone's babies
It's you and I in the thick of it
Taking turns at screaming
When I think about parents dying
It's you I wanna be crying on
In my head we can handle
Everything on fire

What a way to break the contact
How bittersweet
And we cut the bullshit
As you held me through the scream
Cause if honesty is everything
Then you and I, we've got a lot to believe in

So, when I think about having babies
They're not just anyone's babies
It's you and I in the thick of it
Taking turns at screaming
When I think about parents dying
It's you I wanna be crying on
In my head we can handle
Everything on fire

I've been doing the numbers in my head
Telling myself that we've still got time on our hands
Can't get high without thinking of you
I have a feeling we'll always be wondering why

Cause when I think about having babies
They're not just anyone's babies
It's you and I in the thick of it
Taking turns at screaming
When I think about parents dying
It's you I wanna be crying on
In my head we can handle
Everything on fire
